metadata.title: The Fear Gauge Hit 40. What the Market Is Worried About.<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
The Fear Gauge Hit 40. This Is What the Market Is Worried About.
The market’s fear gauge—the Cboe Volatility Index, or VIX—hit 40 on Friday and closed at 37.66, up 32% on the day. That means two things: Investors no longer believe artificial-intelligence numbers and, as hard as it is to believe, the end of the selling is likely near.
